cases.readiness: Requires actual new GPU pool capacity and computed ratio preserving exact host tokens; integer --hicache-size cannot encode baseline exactly.
cases.prediction: miss work and P service/queue fall
cases.rejection: capacity increases but miss does not fall, or miss falls without service/throughput benefit

cases.readiness: Capacity-only case; keep backend=kernel and layout=page_first. Verify live host pool and memory headroom.
cases.rejection: host occupancy changes without P service improvement

cases.readiness: Not ready: verify backend works with unchanged page_first layout, hardware and dtype. If layout change required, this is a combined implementation comparison and needs a separate paired baseline.
cases.prediction: device copy or shared wait time falls at matched workload
cases.rejection: no service improvement or increased errors; do not interpret D transfer wait as DMA time

cases.readiness: P configuration fixed; verify actual D capacity, graph workspace and retractions.
cases.prediction: D allocation tail falls; if causal bottleneck, P queue and completion rate also improve
cases.rejection: only allocation tail improves while C80 throughput and P queue stay unchanged

cases.readiness: Requires scheduler implementation and a control with the identical instrumented build; existing baseline gives workload evidence, not a matched binary control.
cases.prediction: short-request queue decreases with bounded long-request tail and unchanged cache/miss cost
cases.rejection: latency merely shifts to long requests, starvation rises, or miss/throughput worsens

cases.readiness: Prepare shadow audit first. Existing allocation events may not expose both full budget conditions and all candidate rank state; do not claim alternatives feasible from free KV alone.
cases.prediction: same-decision-time complete budget check identifies feasible alternative ranks
cases.rejection: alternatives mostly fail complete budget or reservation checks
